basic_info.description: Amazing Opportunity in Sunnyside!    Charming 2BR/1BA home on the market for the first time in over 50 years! This classic residence is full of potential - perfect for renovation or possible expansion.    Features include:    Bright living room with fireplace  Dining area with skylight  Updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances and skylight  Original bathroom with skylight  Two comfortable bedrooms with crown molding throughout  Additional rooms downstairs offer flexible use  Solar panels installed  Terraced backyard with southern views, a lemon tree, and room for landscaping  This home needs some TLC but offers incredible potential. Bring your contractor and imagination. don't miss this opportunity!  Fantastic Location - Walking distance to Glen Park's village-like atmosphere, stores, restaurants and Bart/public transportation.
